title: Live check with a real crash
goal: The owner logs a crash and asks the questions
acceptance: Copy and paste: `nerv chat "ho crashato Smoke, motore sinistro inferiore rotto"` then `nerv chat "quanti motori di scorta mi restano?"`; expected: the crash listed and the spare count decreased
privacy: Owner fleet and kitchen data stay local-only; tests use invented batteries, drones and recipes.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
Anything that needs a human sense, account or device goes back to the owner as its own step

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-14 from the owner request at agent speed (harness 8.14.3: implementation steps 0.75 h). Not a measurement. Moved to the agent 2026-11-18 (0.25 h owner → agent).
